parsed.note_claim: Cigarettes contain up to 750x the amount of diacetyl than e-cigarettes do, and never caused popcorn lung.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Most of the articles failed to mention there are more of these chemicals in combustible cigarettes, and there are no documented cases of Popcorn Lung being caused by smoking or vaping.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states there are no documented cases of popcorn lung caused by smoking and confirms cigarettes contain more of the chemicals.
